description: Unit tests for number parsing functions in the net namespace, specifically testing ParseInt and ParseUint functions with various inputs, including edge cases like overflow, underflow, and invalid inputs.

methods.name: CreateOverflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one greater than the maximum value of type T.

methods.name: CreateUnderflowString
methods.description: Generates a string representing a number one less than the minimum value of signed type T.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntSuccess
methods.description: Tests that parsing the input string with the given format succeeds and yields the expected output.

methods.name: ExpectParseIntFailure
methods.description: Tests that parsing the input string with the given format fails with the expected error.

methods.name: TestParseIntUsingFormat
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on a ParseInt or ParseUint function with a specific format.

methods.name: TestParseInt
methods.description: Runs tests on a ParseInt function across different formats.

methods.name: TestParseUint
methods.description: Runs tests on a ParseUint function across different formats.
